text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...
To think I lost again...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Always bragging that you'll 'be number one,'
and then look at this mess..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Like this, there's no way
I can stand at the pinnacle of Umamusume...gh!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Like this, there's no way
I can stand at the pinnacle of Umamusume...gh!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I know that already...!
That's why I'm telling myself to get my act together!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
As long as I don't give up,
there are plenty of chances...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whether it takes 100 times or 1,000 times,
I'll run as much as it takes to make my comeback!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course I will!
You didn't even need to tell me that...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch, I'll definitely claw my way up to number one!
I'm never giving up on being the best!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, we're starting training right away!
Naturally, you're joining me!
